text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I just can't seem to find any 
energy~. When I feel this completely 
useless, I should...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-saaann, are you thereee? I'm 
sure she's right around...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh, they turned into a completely 
different person!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm Silence Suzuka. I always have 
been.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Are you looking for Fukukitaru too?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee. Getting a fortune telling from 
Fukukitaru-san always cheers me up when 
I'm feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
When the results are good, I'm happy, but 
even when they're bad, having a good cry 
feels refreshing... Is it the same for 
you, Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here... for fortune-telling. 
Talking with Fukukitaru is just a nice 
change of pace. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you the same? After all, 
regardless of the fortune's result, it 
cheers you up."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right. The fortune results 
don't matter... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-san must just be that kind of 
person, huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, when I'm with you, I can forget all 
my worries.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... wouldn't it be 
better to just tell them? Like, 'I don't 
need a fortune telling, I just want to 
chat.'

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be better... not to say 
anything? It might just end up bumming 
Fukukitaru out instead.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Right... Divination is like my 
life's work, or really, practically my way 
of saying hello.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just not say anything! Because 
when you're full of energy, 
Fukukitaru-san, we're full of energy too!
